notes.title: Patch Notes - v0.5.27
notes.content:
Hello, cleaners! 🧹

We’re back with a fresh update full of improvements, new content, and quality-of-life changes. Here’s what’s new:

🌍 3 New Maps Added!
Take on exciting new cleaning contracts in three fresh locations. More grime, more glory! 🏚✨

💦 Pressure Washer Improvements
We’ve fine-tuned the pressure washing system for smoother, more satisfying cleaning. Say goodbye to stubborn stains!

🚀 Map Optimizations & Bug Fixes
Several existing levels have been optimized and minor bugs have been squashed for a cleaner experience overall.

🖥 UI Enhancements
We’ve polished up the interface and added a new Before/After Skip Button—because sometimes you just want to get to the action!

📝 Language Fixes
Localization has been improved for a more accurate and immersive experience.

Thank you for playing and continuing to support us! More updates are in the works—until then, happy cleaning! 🧼

notes.title: Emergency Cleanup Co. Released
notes.content:
[h1][b]Emergency Cleanup Co. Now in Early Access on Steam![/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44893215/0c3c72c6693375e38abcdbf3fe324da3fb4b45c3.png[/img]

As of today, Emergency Cleanup Co. is live on Steam! Get ready to dive into an epic cleaning adventure and lose yourself in the chaos. This game invites you into a world filled with challenging tasks, hilarious surprises, and unexpected obstacles around every corner.

Game Features:

[list]
[*] Battling the Mess: From hoarder houses to abandoned warehouses, tackle messy and chaotic spaces like never before. Collect trash, organize belongings, and bring each location back to its former glory as you bring order to the chaos.

[*] Advanced Cleaning Mechanics: Test your skills with a variety of cleaning tools, from brooms to heavy-duty machines. Each task presents unique challenges and requires different strategies—are you up for the job?

[*] Unique Scenarios: Every level offers a distinct challenge, enriched with immersive storytelling. You won’t just clean spaces; you’ll uncover secrets and experience the story each place has to tell!
 
[*] Early Access Perks: As one of our first users, your feedback will directly shape the future of the game! Emergency Cleanup Co. will be continuously updated based on your insights to make your experience even more special.
[/list]

Start playing now and become a part of the Emergency Cleanup Co. community! Explore this adventure in early access, share your experiences, and help shape the future of the game. Put on those cleaning gloves, face the chaos head-on, and bring every space back to shine!

Good luck!,
ECC Team

Unique Scenarios: Every level offers a distinct challenge, enriched with immersive storytelling. You won’t just clean spaces; you’ll uncover secrets and experience the story each place has to tell!

Early Access Perks: As one of our first users, your feedback will directly shape the future of the game! Emergency Cleanup Co. will be continuously updated based on your insights to make your experience even more special.
